page.overview:
What is Grandshelt Catacombs?

The Grandshelt Catacombs are a location in Final Fantasy Brave Exvius. This underground passage is connected to Grandshelt Castle, which was built in the northern area of Royal Capital Grandshelt.

According to Sophia, some of lazier Grandshelt knights are often seen frequenting the area, so it is not a good place to discuss sensitive information.

This exploration appears as part of the side quest "A Knight of Grandshelt".
